// ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
// +  CIMTool AsciiDoc editor configuration: Profiles folder  +
// ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
//
// CIMTool creates this file in the project's Profiles folder. The Asciidoctor
// Editor applies it when rendering documents located in this folder, such as the
// articles and inline fragments generated by CIMTool's AsciiDoc builders.
//
// profilesdir is the folder holding the profile artifacts generated by CIMTool.
// The AsciiDoc builders reference their PlantUML diagrams through it, for example
// plantuml::{profilesdir}/MyProfile.rdfs-t2b.puml[]. The editor replaces
// {asciidoctorconfigdir} with the folder containing this file. Master documents
// located elsewhere in the project define their own profilesdir.
:profilesdir: {asciidoctorconfigdir}
//
// For more information please take a look at https://github.com/de-jcup/eclipse-asciidoctor-editor/wiki/Asciidoctor-configfiles
